Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/3-01.htm.text: Priest Bastian: Hello! I've been expecting you! Don't look so surprised! You're here for the Stone of Commune, aren't you? I got this one from Agnes a while back. Don't you wonder how she got it and why she gave it to me? If you knew her, you'd understand! While you were away, there was an accident…

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/3-05.htm.text: Priest Bastian: Wonderful! I didn't think you could do it so quickly in the middle of a war! Could I see the stone for a moment? I can use it to create a Stone of Commune if you so desire.

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/3-04.htm.text: Priest Bastian: Did you get the Divine Stone of Wisdom? Find the 'Divine Stone of Wisdom' by winning the trust of Asefa, chief shaman of the Ketra Orcs, or Udan Mardui, chief shaman of the Varka Silenos. If that doesn't work, speak to Ketra's Messenger Wahkan or Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk.

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/3-06.htm.text: Priest Bastian: What are you still doing here? Our destiny approaches! This Stone of Commune is the most powerful I've ever seen! Take it north of the Varka Silenos barracks .

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/11-01.htm.text: Priest Bastian: Hello again! Isn't Agnes great? I don't know how I ever got by without her! Did you find that Stone of Commune useful? This time, a very important priest asked me to help you.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
